cards.back:
A Latin root meaning water, as in aquarium.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti air
Example: An aquarium is a glass tank full of water and fish.
cards.say: aqua. An aquarium is a glass tank full of water and fish.

cards.back:
A Latin root meaning land or earth, as in terrain.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti tanah
Example: The terrain on the mountain path was rocky and steep.
cards.say: terra. The terrain on the mountain path was rocky and steep.

cards.back:
A Latin root meaning to carry, as in transport.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti membawa
Example: Ships transport goods across the ocean every day.
cards.say: port. Ships transport goods across the ocean every day.

cards.back:
A Latin root meaning to say, as in predict.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti berkata
Example: Scientists predict that the rain will start tomorrow.
cards.say: dict. Scientists predict that the rain will start tomorrow.

cards.back:
A Latin root meaning to see, as in spectator.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti melihat
Example: A spectator cheered loudly from the stands during the final.
cards.say: spect. A spectator cheered loudly from the stands during the final.

cards.back:
A Latin root meaning to write, as in describe.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti menulis
Example: Describe your favourite place using three clear sentences.
cards.say: scrib. Describe your favourite place using three clear sentences.

cards.back:
A Latin root meaning to hear, as in audience.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti mendengar
Example: The audience clapped when the singer finished her song.
cards.say: aud. The audience clapped when the singer finished her song.

cards.back:
A Latin root meaning to see, as in visible.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti melihat
Example: The stars are visible on a clear night.
cards.say: vis. The stars are visible on a clear night.

cards.back:
A Latin root meaning to lead, as in conduct.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti memimpin
Example: The teacher will conduct the choir at the concert.
cards.say: duc. The teacher will conduct the choir at the concert.

cards.back:
A Latin root meaning to build, as in construct.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti membangun
Example: Workers will construct a new bridge over the river.
cards.say: struct. Workers will construct a new bridge over the river.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning life, as in biology.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti hidup
Example: In biology, we study plants, animals and people.
cards.say: bio. In biology, we study plants, animals and people.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning earth, as in geography.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti bumi
Example: In geography, we learned how mountains and rivers are formed.
cards.say: geo. In geography, we learned how mountains and rivers are formed.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning to write or draw, as in autograph.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti menulis atau menggambar
Example: The footballer gave me his autograph on a card.
cards.say: graph. The footballer gave me his autograph on a card.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning light, as in photosynthesis.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti cahaya
Example: Photosynthesis is how plants use light to make food.
cards.say: photo. Photosynthesis is how plants use light to make food.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning far, as in telescope.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti jauh
Example: A telescope lets us see distant planets and faraway stars.
cards.say: tele. A telescope lets us see distant planets and faraway stars.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning small, as in microscope.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti kecil
Example: A microscope shows tiny creatures in a drop of water.
cards.say: micro. A microscope shows tiny creatures in a drop of water.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning heat, as in thermometer.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti panas
Example: A thermometer measures how hot or cold something is.
cards.say: therm. A thermometer measures how hot or cold something is.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning sound, as in telephone.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti bunyi
Example: I called my grandmother on the telephone last night.
cards.say: phon. I called my grandmother on the telephone last night.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning time, as in chronicle.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti waktu
Example: The chronicle recorded the events of each year in the village.
cards.say: chron. The chronicle recorded the events of each year in the village.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning water, as in hydroelectric.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti air
Example: The dam makes hydroelectric power for the whole town.
cards.say: hydro. The dam makes hydroelectric power for the whole town.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning human, as in anthropology.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti manusia
Example: Anthropology is the study of people and their customs.
cards.say: anthropo. Anthropology is the study of people and their customs.

cards.back:
A Greek root meaning star, as in astronomy.
Bahasa Indonesia: akar kata berarti bintang
Example: Astronomy is the study of stars, planets and space.
cards.say: astro. Astronomy is the study of stars, planets and space.
